question: The word “untapped” means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Not yet used or developed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"untapped"** means:

 
 
• Not yet used or developed; not exploited. (अभी तक उपयोग या विकास नहीं किया गया; अप्रयुक्त)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The region's untapped natural resources could be a boost to the economy.
 
• **"Correct answer"** means:
 
 
• Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured him a perfect score.

Therefore, the word “untapped” means: **Not yet used or developed.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fully used** (पूरी तरह उपयोग किए गए): Used completely, as much as possible.

 
 
• **Example:** The factory's resources were fully used in the production process.
 
 
 
• **Forgotten forever** (हमेशा के लिए भूल जाना): Not remembered at all for an indefinite period.
 
 
• **Example:** The old methods remained forgotten forever once the new technology was adopted.
 
 
 
• **Hidden in books** (पुस्तकों में छिपा): Concealed or kept within the pages of literature.
 
 
• **Example:** Many historical secrets are hidden in books.
 
 

49:Td6c,
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.
